title: polanisia dodecandra subsp. uniglandulosa
intro: Polanisia dodecandra subsp. uniglandulosa, commonly known as "snail flower" or "snail seed," is a plant species within the Nymphaeaceae family. This plant is traditionally used for its medicinal properties and has been shown to have various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, which can help to alleviate conditions such as fever, skin infections, and respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of Polanisia dodecandra subsp. uniglandulosa include its ability to stimulate the immune system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and health benefits.
